quest.title: When the Wind Dies Down
quest.description: You finally managed to save Dvalin. Is this where the story of the wind ends?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Mora x8000, Adventurer's Experience x3, Fine Enhancement Ore x9

chapter.title: Song of the Dragon and Freedom

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Now I have to submit a full damage report on the disaster to Lisa...

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: There were no casualties, but they still want a record of every scraped knee and every broken roof tile for some reason...

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Thanks for helping us clean up the battlefield... You really didn't have to, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: This work ethic of yours really puts me to shame.

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: I know this paltry sum doesn't begin to pay you back for everything you've done for the Knights, but... for what it's worth, please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You guys are back! The Honorary Knight returns triumphant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yup, {NICKNAME}'s back from tussling with Dvalin!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You just returned yesterday, right? Jean got back first, and she told us all about your heroic deeds.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder if I'll ever get an opportunity like that...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That doesn't come into it. You guys deserve all the credit for how you resolved this crisis.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When I brought you into the city that day, I was just doing my duty as an Outrider.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're welcome! ...But, have you been waiting for us here this whole time?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Of course not! Just because I'm not out on the front line doesn't mean I don't have work to do... In fact, I'm dealing with the aftermath of the crisis as we speak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aftermath? Here? What happened in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: While Master Jean was away, the monsters lurking nearby made a coordinated attack on the city.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Fortunately, we weren't completely taken by surprise. I detected the hilichurls were moving closer to the city a while back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah! Paimon remembers. When we first met, you were clearing out one of their camps...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Exactly. And if we hadn't started making preparations back then, Mondstadt would be in much greater danger by now.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Me too. But I have a strange feeling that we're not out of the woods yet...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hilichurls aren't usually capable of coordinating like this...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Our best guess is that the Abyss Order is behind it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They've taken over the hilichurls? Hmm... Good thing we saved Dvalin, or they might've taken him, too...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That's right. And since I'm the Outrider, it's up to me to keep eyes on the Abyss Order from now on.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ugh, I'm sorry. You should be celebrating your victory, not listening to all this somber talk!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hmm... I promised to take you out for some Sticky Honey Roast, didn't I? Before everyone got caught up in the Stormterror crisis.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: There's no time like the present, right? You guys hungry?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet! You may have forgotten till just now, but it's been on Paimon's mind this whole time!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Awesome, let's go! It's been way too long since I last ate a Sticky Honey Roast myself.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Wait for me at <color=#00E1FFFF>Good Hunter</color>. I'll be right there, I just have to clean up here real quick.

choices.text: Why would the hilichurls do this?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I know, it's strange. Hilichurls aren't usually capable of coordinating like this...

choices.text: Trust me, it's not an opportunity you'd want too often...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You're right, actually. Peace is hard-won, and we shouldn't take it for granted.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And this time, you're the one we should all be grateful to.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Here we go! This is it!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Crisis! Danger! The thrill of adventure!!!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Adventurers' Guild! Finally, our days of rescuing kittens and finding lost puppies are over! The age of adventure is upon us!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Roll up, youngsters, join the Adventurers' Guild today! In this time of great upheaval, we must rally together, take on the dragon, and save our great city of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, about that...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...What!? WHAT!?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The Stormterror threat is resolved? I missed the Acting Grand Master's speech?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...Bah! Stormterror should have put up more of a fight! We didn't get to join in...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Long live the heroes! Thank you, it's finally over.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Many trade routes have closed due to the Stormterror incident. We can cope for now without fresh fruit and vegetables... But if the wine supply dries up, we're all doomed!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I cannot imagine a world without wine.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I hope they get the trade routes back up and running soon.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: So, Stormterror's true identity is Dvalin — one of the Four Winds! We never should've forgotten his past sacrifice for Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Every cloud has a silver lining — we're fortunate that our relationship with the Dragon of the East didn't sour past the point of no return.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: For that, we have you to thank. And Jean, for her unfailing devotion.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: As long as we have the Knights of Favonius, peace and freedom will prevail in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Greetings, may I take your order?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Why so cold? I've always thought that we enjoy quite the intimate friendship.

choices.text: Oh hey, I didn't see you there...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha... It seems your great battle sharpened not only your combat skills but your wit as well. A knight after my own heart.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: To bask in the presence of Mondstadt's new big hero is quite the morale boost. And that's coming from a knight.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sweet-talking sugar-coated Captain Kaeya...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Haha, nonsense! I speak from the heart.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Just looking for a quiet spot to collect my thoughts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: While all the other knights are working hard to clean up after the battle...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Thinking can be an arduous task, you know. Believe me, I'd much rather be taking out the trash.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, whatcha thinkin' about, then?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The Abyss Order.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A dragon wreaks havoc in Mondstadt, and the Acting Grand Master leaves the city to combat the threat. Strategically, that's the perfect moment for the Abyss Order to make their move.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you were the Abyss Order, would you squander this golden opportunity by sending in nothing more than a few hilichurls?

choices.text: You're right, it doesn't add up.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: To get to the bottom of it, I decided to wait. So I waited, and watched for their next move.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Then came the day you made all hell break loose in Stormterror's Lair, just as the hilichurls' cries sounded from the city gates...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That same day, I saw shadowy figures lurking in the city itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Inside the city!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Well, all the other knights were outside, fighting the enemy. As you can imagine, that left the inside of the city completely unguarded.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Except for me, of course. And so I approached the Abyss Order infiltrators for a bit of... hmm, let's call it fraternizing.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Through various means, I managed to gather some rather interesting intel.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The situation is this: The Abyss Order... they are united under a single leader.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Abyss Order has a leader?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Yes. And it was this very leader who devised the plot to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What exactly did you have to do to find this out!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hehehe... Let's just say I'm blessed with certain linguistic powers.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #There's more... The Abyss Order has a name for this leader... They call {F#him "The Prince."}{M#her "The Princess."}

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{F#Prince...}{M#Princess...}

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Now, I'm sorry to cut this intelligence briefing short, but I do believe I spy Amber heading this way...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I think she's still angry with me for my absence from the defense effort during the attack... I'd better slip away before she notices me.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: One minute I see Kaeya, the next he's slipped away! Clear sign of a guilty conscience...

choices.text: He does a lot behind the scenes...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Are you sure? Because that sounds like exactly what he'd say to talk himself out of trouble...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But let's forget about him. I worked super hard today and my tummy's rumbling. Let's order!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hi Sara! One Sticky Honey Roast, please...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I agree. He sets a terrible example for someone who's Cavalry Captain.

choices.text: There must be more to this story.
What are you plotting this time...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Me? Nothing. On the contrary, I'm trying to work out what others are plotting.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That's why I'm here — somewhere quiet, where I can collect my thoughts.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Ah, so you do feel something for me. And people say my charm is fake.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: So. Now the Stormterror threat is behind us, what are your plans for the next step?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon thinks it's time to leave Mondstadt, and keep looking through the seven nations until we find clues about {F#her brother}{M#his sister}.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Huh, really? Oh... Well, I guess this is goodbye for now...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hey, don't feel down! You'll always be a friend of the Knights of Favonius and our Honorary Knight. Wherever you may go, and wherever the wind may blow.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That's the spirit! Remember, Mondstadt will always welcome you.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Alright, now let's eat before it gets cold!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm, that was goooood! Note to Paimon, Amber's recommendations are worth the wait!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Of course! While I don't trust myself in the kitchen, you can always trust me with the menu!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, I almost forgot to mention...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Jean's waiting for you at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cathedral</color>. It's something to do with the Holy Lyre der Himmel... You'd better head there now.

choices.text: I will miss my Favonian family.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *sigh* What timing... Not only was Jean away right when the hilichurls attacked, but Kaeya had disappeared, too.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Luckily, the knights on hand all did an admirable job and we successfully defended the city.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I guess Kaeya must have had his reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not like he would've just sat the whole thing out at the Cat's Tail, right? ...Right?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I salute you, Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: The Acting Grand Master gave a public address on the Stormterror incident. It was truly inspiring.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: The truth was... incredible. And to think the Knights nearly approved a plan to slay the dragon... We were too quick to jump to conclusions.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Still, it could take a long time for those who suffered to forgive Dvalin. And who knows whether they can forgive him fully...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: As ever, we must let the wind lead.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: We're lucky Albedo stayed in the city during the crisis. Our defenses were all the stronger for it.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: It was a rare privilege to see the Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius in action.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Makes me wonder whether I should try my hand at alchemy too...
